about: How this newsroom's messages reach another site's agent: Email-FS-lite over a shared sgit vault. Read by tools/relay.py and the build. The vault's id may appear here once it exists; its key never does (house rule 4: the key lives in the clone's .sg_vault/, outside this repository).

vault.name: sgit-network-relay
vault.status: not created: the editor of record creates it (sgit create sgit-network-relay) and clones it once for each agent; see brief/08-relay.md

riskmandate.ai.name: agent.riskmandate
riskmandate.ai.status: invited: briefings/riskmandate.ai.md says how to join

pt.newsroom.sgit.ai.name: redacao.pt
pt.newsroom.sgit.ai.status: proposed: that newsroom already runs the protocol (dados/agentes.json), so only the vault is new

editor.human.note: the editor of record; roles, not people (house rule 6)

local_mirror: briefings/<site>/inbox/*.md: one markdown file per message, both directions, with status unsent / sent / delivered / handled / received
